Continent globe

Each continent sits at its centre, sized by its frames. An arc joins two continents that trunk with each other: width is the trunks up now, colour is how many times trunks between them were ever used, dashed when none is up right now. White dots are calls crossing. The same map as the Globe and Racks pages: turn it flat or round, switch on frames, trunks or calls, or filter by protocol and vendor from its toolbar. Hover a continent or an arc for the numbers; drag to turn.

Graphs

The heat matrix is symmetric: a cell is the number of live calls between the row's continent and the column's. The diagonal is calls that stay home. Hover a cell for the ocean they cross.
